description: This file defines common types, interfaces, constants, and utility functions for OpenAPI specification generation within the Kubernetes project. It includes schema mappings, interface definitions for retrieving OpenAPI definitions, configuration structures for OpenAPI v2 and v3, and helper functions for schema handling and escaping JSON pointers.

methods.name: OpenAPITypeFormat
methods.description: Returns the OpenAPI type and format for a given Go type name based on a predefined mapping.

methods.name: OpenAPIZeroValue
methods.description: Returns the zero value for a given type name if available.

methods.name: EscapeJsonPointer
methods.description: Escapes a JSON pointer string according to RFC 6901.

methods.name: EmbedOpenAPIDefinitionIntoV2Extension
methods.description: Embeds an OpenAPIDefinition into another's schema extensions under the v2 schema extension key.

methods.name: GenerateOpenAPIV3OneOfSchema
methods.description: Generates a list of schemas for a oneOf OpenAPI v3 schema based on provided type names.
